answer: Answer: The partner investigation review reported that the raised assembly did not have adequate independent positive mechanical control. This supports an inadequate gravity-restraint finding, but does not establish the precise location or presence/absence of every possible block in the yoke pocket. Support: GTDE-05_task_loto_review.md, Review findings: gravity remained hazardous after hydraulic shutdown and the reported field condition did not provide adequate independent positive mechanical control. Source class: controlled benchmark derivative of partner investigation findings, not an original signed inspection record. Limit: The original signed field record, block inventory, installation photograph and rated support specification were not supplied. A blank block-ID field in the earlier synthetic lockout form establishes a documentation gap, not by itself proof that no block physically existed. No evidence supplied establishes that personnel knowingly relied on wedging as an approved support strategy.
